full_name: Darrick Hamilton | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2025–2026 Social Sciences Katherine Hampson Bessell Fellow The New School
bio: Darrick Hamilton is a university professor, the Henry Cohen Professor of Economics and Urban Policy, and the founding director of the Institute on Race, Power and Political Economy at the New School and the chief economist of the AFL-CIO. At Radcliffe, Hamilton, one of the pioneers in the economic field of identity group stratification, will continue his work to redefine how an economy should work, to identify powerful opportunities for investment in human capacity, and to interrogate strategies that propel collaboration to advance the realization of economic inclusion, social equity, and civic engagement for people around the globe.
